assumptions.affordability: 4-person household at $93,050 (bottom of HCD low band); 30% of income; 1.1% property tax; HOA $350/mo; insurance $120/mo — ASSUMPTION
assumptions.scoring_weights: pathway 30 / size 20 / zoning 15 / hazards 15 / transit 10 / opportunity 10 / city program 10; slope >15% −15 — ASSUMPTION
assumptions.ownership: religious-use parcels are a proxy for SB 4 eligibility; ownership not verified
assumptions.homes: Homes that fit = the city's Housing Element capacity where listed; otherwise open (unroofed) land from the county building-footprint layer × 20 homes/acre (ASSUMPTION), church land using half its open land (ASSUMPTION), empty single-family lots capped at 4 (SB 9), other empty lots at 10 (SB 684). Under 400 m² open = 0.
assumptions.rank: Rank (for a small nonprofit) = lots up to 5 open acres first, then min(homes, 24) × 0.6 if in a flood/fire/liquefaction zone × 0.7 if it does not pencil even at 0% (ASSUMPTIONS).

meta.ranking: v2: homes that fit × hazard factor × pencil factor (see assumptions)
